concept.title: OpenShift Assisted Installer
concept.shortdesc: The OpenShift Assisted Installer assistant can help you create, configure, and install OpenShift Container Platform clusters using the Assisted Installer.

conbody.p: It can help you find information such as a list of your OpenShift clusters, available OpenShift versions, and more.

link.linktext: Installing OpenShift Container Platform with the Assisted Installer
